round_3_2026_10_06.root_cause: hiding with `ViewportCommand::Visible(false)` clears WS_VISIBLE; Windows sends no WM_PAINT to an invisible window, eframe paints only on RedrawRequested, and tray commands were read inside App::update — so after the hide no frame ever ran again (minimizing is no escape: nothing visible, nothing painted)
round_3_2026_10_06.fix: layered hide that keeps WS_VISIBLE (windows::hide_main_window / reveal_main_window), tray commands received on two blocking relay threads and applied from a queue, an OS-level reveal for window commands or when frames::is_stale(), and a transparent clear colour for the transparent viewports
round_3_2026_10_06.height_contract: button / icon button / text input / combo box / labelled button = 24.00 pt (Spacing::control_height); `TextEdit` shrinks its reply to the inner rect, so the test measures the rect the control occupies (egui 0.29 text_edit/builder.rs:416)

round_4_2026_10_07.trigger: product owner re-reported the identical freeze after df2a4eb (green CI): “no tray menu item works, the app looks hung, it has to be ended from the Task Manager”
round_4_2026_10_07.why_the_first_fix_failed: `windows::hide_main_window` kept WS_VISIBLE but called SW_MINIMIZE to give the keyboard back; a minimized window has nothing on screen to paint, so WM_PAINT and App::update stop — and the relay threads only *queued* the commands that App::update would have applied. The menu still opened because the OS draws it on the app's message pump.

rounds.detail: `SWP_NOZORDER` missing from reveal_main_window’s import list (E0425); `LogControl::log_file` returned Option<Arc<PathBuf>> where Option<&Path> was promised (E0308)
two failing tests: the file append lived in the fmt writer instead of LogBuffer::push (a line pushed by the app never reached the file), and the SW_MINIMIZE guard matched the module’s own prose

fix: hide_main_window: alpha 0 + click-through + tool-window + WS_EX_NOACTIVATE + bottom of the z-order; never SW_MINIMIZE, never clear WS_VISIBLE; the extended style is restored if SetLayeredWindowAttributes refuses

the tray relays act: Show/New download reveal through the OS from the relay thread; state-dependent commands are rescued with a reveal when frames::is_stale(); Quit reveals and arms FORCE_QUIT_MS = 8000 (the graceful shutdown is capped at 5000), after which the process ends itself and logs why

the window handle is captured twice (CreationContext, then the first frame) and otherwise searched for among this process's own unowned top-level windows by title rank (RDM = 2, rdm — … = 0), validated with IsWindow before every use
hidden-window heartbeat 1 s (was 250 ms) and frames::STALE_MS 2 s (was 1 s), so a healthy hidden app is never rescued as if it were dead
every captured line is appended to rdm-gui.log in the data directory, one line per open; the relays log each command and whether they armed; the hide decision logs its result

round_5_2026_10_07.trigger: the product owner reported three defects from the running build: (1) with the window in the tray a right click opened the menu, which closed at once while the window came to the front, (2) Help and Settings had no padding around their content, (3) the icon of a button with a label was glued to the label

causes.tray: `tray-icon` 0.26 sends a `TrayIconEvent::Click` for every button and both edges on Windows, and shows the menu itself on the right-button release; both readers of that channel matched `Click { .. }` with no button filter, so the right click became `TrayCommand::Show` -> `reveal_main_window()` -> `SetForegroundWindow`, which took the foreground from the popup and dismissed the menu that click had just opened
causes.padding: `views/help_overlay.rs` and `views/settings_view.rs` drew their content in `Frame::none()`, which insets nothing at all
causes.icon_gap: `components::icon_text_button` reserved the icon slot with three literal spaces and painted the icon at a fixed inset, so how much room the label left depended on the font; on the shipped font the label's ink began inside the icon rectangle

fixes: `tray::command_for_icon_event`: `Show` only for `MouseButton::Left` with `MouseButtonState::Up` (or the left double click); right, middle, enter/move/leave map to nothing; both readers of the channel go through the one function
`theme::window_frame` and `Spacing::window_padding` (12 x 10), used by both windows; the help window's `add_space(xs)` substitute is gone

`components::icon_text_layout` and `Spacing::icon_in_button` (16 pt): the control is sized from the measured label and the tokens, and the icon and the label are painted into `Button::new("").min_size(layout.size)`, whose label is reported through `WidgetInfo::labeled`
